title: Indian Army AFMS B Sc. Nursing Course 2026 Online Form
organization: Indian Army / Armed Forces Medical Services (MNS)
postName: B.Sc. Nursing Course under AFMS / Military Nursing Service
vacancyDetails: About 220 seats for female candidates in B.Sc. Nursing at AFMS institutions (NEET UG based)
qualification: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology; only female candidates; must have appeared/qualified NEET UG 2026 as per notice
ageLimit: As per Army AFMS B.Sc. Nursing notification (typically 17–25 years band)
applicationFee: As per Join Indian Army / AFMS notice (often nil or as notified)
selectionProcess: NEET UG score → Online registration on Join Indian Army → Screening / Interview / Medical as per MNS process
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.joinindianarmy.nic.in or join.afms.gov.in
2. Open B.Sc. Nursing / AFMS admission link after NEET result
3. Register with email and mobile
4. Fill form, upload documents, submit
5. Track further screening schedule
shortDescription: Indian Army AFMS B.Sc. Nursing Course 2026 Online Form – female candidates apply via joinindianarmy.nic.in (NEET UG based, ~220 seats).
content:
Armed Forces Medical Services / Indian Army invites female candidates for B.Sc. Nursing Course 2026 under Military Nursing Service.

Registration is online on joinindianarmy.nic.in (window reported around mid/late July 2026). Admission is linked with NEET UG 2026 performance. Only unmarried female candidates meeting educational and medical standards should apply.
